main_text.p: adiumétiq; cõseruaretur. At- que hæc quidē de scripti am-[illegible, ~8 letters]biguitate dicta. Ex scripti aūt [illegible, ~8 letters]sententiæq; contētione tū ori-[illegible, ~6 letters]tur cōtrouersia,cum,ut Cicero ait, alter uerbis ipsis quæ scripta sunt utitur:alter ad id quod scriptorē sensisse dicet, omnē adiungit dictionē.qua in quæstione ea nobis diligēter tenenda regula est, quam Marcellus tradit in L. 69. D. de legat. lib. tertio: Non aliter à significatione uerborū recedi oportere, quàm cum manifestum est aliud sensisse testatorem . Huius autem quæstioni exemplum è causa Curiana Cicero protulit.

page.notes: The running head and the three left-margin notes are set in bold ornamented type and are too damaged to read; they are marked illegible with estimated lengths. The catchword "Pa-" is at the right foot, below the last full line. The "Cice-/ro" line break shows no printed hyphen, so it is written as "Cicero".
